method: Three independent public Fiction careers; up to three publicly available positional families each; repeated negotiation, public-cash negative control, exact complete-profile forks and actual confirmed auctions.
limits: Different checkpoints are not the same world or a causal experiment.
Only quoted positive need is observed; non-offers have no per-club reason.
Public coach reaction personality is not a tactical identity or evidence of recruitment motive.
No hidden player rating, potential, skill, condition or private decision score selects a target.
Full profiles and exported career states are never published.
This negotiated-release channel does not execute or qualify an autonomous transfer window.
